test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 10 parcels is 28.6 kg. The addition of a new parcel reduces the average weight by 0.6 kg. What is the weight (in kg) of the new parcel?
solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 10 parcels = 28.6 kg

**Formula used:**

{Average}={The sum of the all itemsover The total number of items }

**Calculation:**

Let the weight of new parcels be X

The sum of the all the items = 28.6 × 10 = 286

The new items = 28.6 - 0.6 = 28 kg

The sum of all the items with new items = 286 + X

⇒ {28}={286+Xover11}

⇒ 28 × 11 = 286 + X

⇒ 308 = 286 + X

⇒ 308 - 286 = X

⇒ X = 22

**∴ The required result will be 22 kg.**
